scenarios.why: LGDPDB01's scenario no-commarea through LGDPOL01: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: LGDPDB01's scenario short-commarea through LGDPOL01: #4270 (X23): the caller passed 20 bytes, fewer than WS-CA-HEADER-LEN (28): IF EIBCALEN IS LESS THAN WS-CA-HEADER-LEN (line 143) is true -- '98', RETURN; no DELETE, no LINK. The COMMAREA it leaves is compared over its 20 bytes

scenarios.name: delete-fails
scenarios.why: LGDPDB01's DELETE fails (SQLCODE -904): it sets CA-RETURN-CODE '90' and LINKs LGSTSQ, whose WRITEQ runs past its FROM item and is written padded (X6, ASSUMED): the whole task is compared, so LGDPOL01's If CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 (line 127) is reached

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgdpol01: the Db2 tables are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (the generate block of genapp-lgdpdb01-generated: FKs, NULLs and boundary values, seed 4507), not GenApp's INSERTs. The scenarios are genapp-lgdpdb01-generated's, written against those rows and run through LGDPOL01, which LINKs LGDPDB01, plus the front end's own row-independent paths. Not carried over: genapp-lgdpdb01-generated's short-commarea-delete-fails (a COMMAREA past EIBCALEN with an injected DELETE fault): through the front end the error logger's reference past EIBCALEN is the refused X23 case, which the harness does not model on either side; the front end's own delete-fails covers the fault.
